newsitem.title: USA: CompuCom says Q1 earnings below expectation.
newsitem.headline: CompuCom says Q1 earnings below expectation.

text.p: CompuCom Systems Inc said Friday it anticipates softness in sales growth for the first quarter of 1997, resulting in lower-than-expected earnings.
The First Call estimate for the quarter, which ends March 31, is $0.12 a share.

The company said it currently expects first quarter revenue to be between $425 million and $450 million, with product growth essentially flat and service growth of about 60 percent compared to the year-earlier period.

CompuCom said it believes the slowdown in product growth is temporary, with customers postponing projects due to smaller-than-expected manufacturer price cuts and confusion over which processor to buy. Both of these issues, said the company, should be resolved is the next quarter.
The company also said that it expects the impact of its first-quarter revenue shortfall to be mitigated by strong service growth and lower expenses.
CompuCom is a provider of distributed desktop products and network integration services for large corporate customers.
